issues.detail: The previous rejection misdecoded RVA 0x18445: bytes 8b5208 load EDX from [EDX+8], leaving EAX zero after the successor test. Bytes 89511c then store EDX to list.tail. The current candidate correctly returns zero for a found tail. The historical 528 candidate mismatches belong to source ef64a41e..., whereas the current source is 9916d667.... Current negative-control mismatches are expected.

Independent source inspection against the supplied bytes supports the scoped mapping: raw-address search, empty/miss returns, predecessor/head repair, repeated target.next read, successor/tail repair, full 32-bit EAX and conditional ECX all agree. Arena read/write order matches at the GuestMemory operation level. No target fields are read on a miss; target bytes and unrelated arena bytes remain unchanged within the disjoint canonical domain.

Guest addresses remain unsigned integers rather than host pointers. Contract bounds keep address translation and field accesses within the arena; unsigned arithmetic has defined semantics. GuestMemory uses checked bytewise little-endian accesses with unsigned shifts of at most 24 bits, permitting unaligned objects without alignment or effective-type violations. Overlap, malformed graphs and address wrap remain excluded.

Identity is consistently bound to DAOrigins.exe SHA-256 2346caee611002d4dff6ecef68eb315b63a37004dd98b39c11a9c26c0b45bfb3, RVA 0x18400, and capture SHA-256 c5eeb9077a1596efc91e13f4cd9218ff0e93fed2e4aa349a87b31578edd18754, including the unreachable alignment gap. Supplied verified bindings connect the current source, frozen contract/corpora, reference and executables. Raw-file and canonical-JSON digest domains are explicitly distinguished. Current reports record 1040 public passes, 128 heldout passes and 528 expected ECX-mutant mismatches without reported errors.

limitations: Review used only supplied material; no tools or independent hash recomputation. Detailed original traces and backend implementation were represented partly by hash-bound review reports.

The C++ API models full EAX and observed ECX. Original RET 4, preserved registers and conditional balanced ESI stack save are documented original-side behavior; this package does not establish a working x86 thiscall bridge or reproduce guest private-stack writes.

Recorded candidate execution used macOS ARM64 AppleClang 21 C++20 against Unicorn 2.1.4 original execution. Corpus agreement and synthetic controls are bounded evidence, not native Windows validation or universal proof.

Approval covers only the initialized 512-byte arena, four-node canonical disjoint domain. It excludes aliases/overlap, malformed graphs, faults/MMIO, concurrency, allocator/lifetime, Windows synchronization and whole-game behavior.
No registry integration or replacement executable is approved.
